description: This Java class, PrefixedActorNameFactory, generates actor names with specific prefixes for use in an Akka-based system. It ensures thread-safe creation of actor names by appending a base64-encoded counter value to a given prefix.

classes.name: PrefixedActorNameFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating prefixed actor names with thread safety and a counter-based unique suffix.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate PrefixedActorNameFactory with a specified prefix.

methods.name: createActorName
methods.description: Generates a new actor name by appending a base64-encoded counter value to the prefix.
